title: Fast Rates for Offline Contextual Bandits with Forward-KL Regularization under Single-Policy Concentrability
abstract: arXiv:2605.09214v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: \emph{Kullback-Leibler} (KL) regularization is ubiquitous in reinforcement learning algorithms in the form of \emph{reverse} or \emph{forward} KL. Recent studies have demonstrated $\epsilon^{-1}$-type fast rates for decision making under reverse KL regularization, in contrast to the standard $\epsilon^{-2}$-type sample complexity. However, for forward-KL-regularized objectives, existing statistical analyses are either not applicable or result in $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ slow rates. We take the first step towards addressing this problem via a streamlined analysis of forward-KL-regularized offline CBs. We give the first $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-1})$ upper bounds in tabular and general function approximation settings, both under notions of \emph{single-policy concentrability}. translated_abstract: KL（Kullback-Leibler）散度正则化以反向KL或前向KL的形式广泛存在于强化学习算法中。最近的研究表明，在反向KL正则化下的决策问题可以达到 ε^{-1} 型的快速收敛率，相比之下标准的样本复杂度为 ε^{-2} 型。然而，对于前向KL正则化的目标函数，现有的统计分析要么不适用，要么只能得到 Õ(ε^{-2}) 的慢收敛率。我们通过对前向KL正则化离线上下文老虎机的精简分析，迈出了解决这一问题的第一步。我们在表格型设置和一般函数逼近设置下，均在单策略集中性的概念下，首次给出了 Õ(ε^{-1}) 的上界。特别地，我们的凸分析流程以一种新颖的方式利用悲观原理统一了这些设置，并完全绕过了证明中的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次在单策略集中性条件下，为前向KL正则化的离线上下文老虎机给出了表格型与一般函数逼近设置下的 Õ(ε^{-1}) 快速收敛率上界，通过新颖地运用悲观原理的凸分析框架填补了前向KL正则化统计分析的空白。
